item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] University of Michigan will begin pass-or-fail-only grades for some of its students

item.description: The Aspen Acres Fire burned 250 grazing acres on a southern Colorado ranch, leaving one rancher facing $40,000 in hay costs amid drought-driven price surges.
